g.text: When Jev reviews an LLM: corrections and new errors

text.style: font-size: 13px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #17293b

g.text: All 48 source→review conditions · Six models · Zero-shot and four examples per class · First attempts

text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #506174

g.text: Bars: percentage of the full test set corrected (right) or harmed (left). Row annotation: corrected / wrong / failed; net pp.
Failures stay in the full N, including upstream failures that prevented review. Hatching isolates damage to an originally correct decision;
other failed rows remain incorrect. Retry recoveries are excluded. Exact counts, accuracies and failure totals are recorded in MANIFEST.json.
Exploratory, unadjusted paired group-bootstrap intervals (2000 resamples; seed 42). One fixed split and prompt recipe per condition.
Models retain their original prompt rendering. This compares two-stage pipelines; it does not isolate bounded decoding on the same LLM. No pooled winner.
